announcements.headline: Directorate change
announcements.insight: This announcement indicates a change in the board composition, which is a standard governance update. Such changes are routine and typically do not signal immediate strategic shifts or material financial impacts for shareholders.

announcements.headline: Annual Financial Report
announcements.insight: This announcement signifies the release of scheduled annual financial results, which provides shareholders with a comprehensive review of the company's performance over the past year. The headline does not indicate the direction of the results or any specific material events, so it represents standard periodic reporting rather than a catalyst for immediate price movement.
